outcome: fluid in the pubic symphysis joint
cohort: 30 healthy women (17 vaginal deliveries, 13 cesarean deliveries) with a mean age of 33.2 ± 4 years for vaginal deliveries and 35.2 ± 5.6 years for cesarean deliveries
finding: Pubic bone marrow edema is highly prevalent in the first postpartum week and is not significantly different between vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the prevalence of pubic bone marrow edema between women who had vaginal deliveries and those who had cesarean sections.
